How a Moving Block Enters the Contracted Third Derivative

Source: R/outer_refresh.R
contract3_refresh.Rd

The part of \(T[v] = (\partial K/\partial\beta)\cdot v\) that contract3 does not compute, as a matrix over the stacked coefficients.

Usage

contract3_refresh(spec, design, params, npar, offs, total, dir, Hl, units)

Arguments

spec

A StatmodSpec.

design

The design.

params, npar, offs, total

The block bookkeeping.

dir

One entry per unit, from refresh_direction.

Hl

The link-scale curvature, from refresh_hessian.

units

The refreshable terms, from refresh_units.

Value

A square matrix, whose transpose completes the correction.

Details

Differentiating \(H\) in \(\beta\) and contracting with \(v\) leaves, beside the third derivative contract3 carries, two terms in \(\partial X/\partial\beta\): with \(D_a = (\partial X_a/\partial\beta)v\), $$R[(a,j),(b,k)] = -\sum_i w_i\,\ell_{ab,i}\,D_a[i,j]\,X_b[i,k],$$ and the other is its transpose, so the correction is \(R + R^\top\). The derivative is asked of the TERM through term_block_deriv and never differenced here, for the reason u_refresh records: a break-point column is a step function in its break-point.

See also

contract3, u_refresh
